labs.desc: An AI-native collections workspace, prioritize accounts, predict risk, recommend the next best action, and drive down DSO.
labs.name: AI Collections Cloud
labs.blurb: A complete PM case study, end to end. AI Collections Cloud turns fragmented AR data into next-best-action workflows, built from the painful workflow through the PRD, the journey, the metrics, the architecture, the tradeoffs, and a working prototype.

products.why: Every extra day an invoice sits unpaid is working capital frozen. Slow, inconsistent collector decisions inflate DSO and let recoverable money age into bad debt. For the collector, the pain is decision fatigue, too many accounts, too little context, and no clear signal on where the next hour should go.
products.name: AI Collections Cloud
products.next: Close the loop: let the copilot auto-log call outcomes, learn which recommendations convert to payment, and re-rank the queue from real results.
products.what:
Collections teams burn their day on decisions, not collecting. Who to call first, what to say, which account is about to slip, which dispute is silently blocking a payment, and what should happen next, every one of those is a judgment call made across a fragmented stack of ERP screens, spreadsheets, email threads, and call notes.

The bet: turn that fragmented AR data into next-best-action workflows. AI Collections Cloud reads the full account picture, scores risk with reasons, and tells the collector exactly what to do next, then drafts the email and logs the outcome.
products.tagline: An AI-powered collections workspace that prioritizes accounts, predicts risk, recommends the next best action, and drives down DSO.
products.testing: That a ranked queue plus an explicit next-best-action, not another dashboard, is what actually shortens collector decision time and lifts recovery rate.
features: Predicts delayed-payment risk per account and shows the reason codes behind every score.
Recommends the single highest-leverage move, call, email, escalate, dispute follow-up, or promise-to-pay reminder.
Summarizes account history, drafts the outreach email, and suggests a negotiation tone.
Detects root cause, groups similar disputes, and routes each to the right team.
Tracks DSO, aging, collector productivity, and recovery rate in one live view.

labs.desc: A guided, state-based loan-origination platform, lift completion, speed up KYC and decisioning, and shorten approval turnaround.
labs.name: LOS, Loan Origination System
labs.blurb: A complete PM case study, end to end. LOS moves a borrower from application to approval with fewer handoffs, built from the painful workflow through the PRD, the journey, the metrics, the state machine, the tradeoffs, and a working prototype.

products.why: Drop-off is the silent killer of loan volume, borrowers abandon long, opaque journeys, and approved-but-slow applications lose to faster competitors. Internally, manual KYC and document chasing eat the team's capacity and stretch approval TAT.
products.name: LOS, Loan Origination System
products.next: Layer in lightweight decisioning assists, document auto-extraction and rule-based pre-checks, to cut KYC retries and analyst back-and-forth.
products.what:
Loan journeys are slow for the same reasons everywhere: long forms, the same documents uploaded twice, manual KYC, no visibility into status, and credit decisions that disappear into a queue.

The bet: a guided, state-based LOS that moves a borrower from application to approval with fewer handoffs. Every applicant always knows their current state and the single next step; every bank team works from one shared workflow instead of chasing paper.
products.tagline: A digital loan-origination platform that lifts application completion, speeds up KYC and credit decisioning, and shortens approval turnaround.
products.testing: That making state and the next step explicit at every stage is what reduces drop-off and shortens approval TAT, more than any single faster step.
features: Dynamic fields that save progress and cut repeated data entry.
Upload, validate, and retry, with missing documents always shown.
Basic product-fit rules with a soft decline and a next-best offer.
Clear state transitions, pending, approved, referred, rejected.
The borrower always sees the current status and the next step.

artifacts.goal: Increase completed loan applications and reduce approval turnaround time.
artifacts.label: PRD

artifacts.after: The borrower sees status, missing items, and the next step; bank teams work one shared workflow end to end.
artifacts.label: Before / After
artifacts.before: The borrower submits forms and waits blindly while bank teams chase documents and KYC by hand.

products.name: Cohort
products.what:
Cohort makes retention investigable. Instead of a flat curve, it lets a team slice survival by acquisition source, first-week behavior, and feature adoption, then quantifies which early actions actually predict long-term return.

This lab covers the analytical framing and the experiment design behind every claim.
products.tagline: Retention analysis that finally answers 'which users come back, and what made them.'
features: Group users by what they did, not just when they joined.
The early actions that predict retention.
Every insight ships with a testable hypothesis.

products.name: Signal
products.what:
Signal watches the metric tree and learns each line's normal rhythm, so it can tell a genuine anomaly from ordinary noise. When something real breaks, it routes a concise, contextual alert to the right owner, and stays quiet otherwise.

Analytics Lab holds the detection model and the false-positive tuning that makes the alerts trusted.
products.tagline: Anomaly detection for business metrics that pages a human only when it's worth it.
features: Knows the difference between a dip and a Tuesday.
The right person, with context, not a firehose.

labs.desc: The semantic spine, entity models, master data, and the schemas that make a business legible to software and AI.
labs.name: Data & Entity Lab
labs.blurb: A shared language for the business. Data & Entity Lab is where the domain gets modeled, entities, relationships, master data, and the semantic layer that lets analytics, products, and AI all mean the same thing by the same word.

products.name: Graphmind
products.what:
Graphmind is the canonical entity model for the lending domain, borrowers, accounts, obligations, events, expressed as a graph that products, analytics, and AI all share. One definition of 'delinquency,' used everywhere.

Data & Entity Lab holds the ontology, the governance, and the migration that consolidated five conflicting schemas into one.
products.tagline: A knowledge graph of the lending domain that every product and model reads from.
features: Shared definitions across every team and system.
Schema evolution with review, not surprise.
Consolidated conflicting legacy models into a spine.

products.name: Registry
products.what:
Registry resolves the same customer appearing five times across five systems into a single golden record, matched, merged, and survivorship-ruled, so downstream products stop arguing about who the customer is.

This lab covers the matching logic, the survivorship rules, and the stewardship workflow for the hard cases.
products.tagline: Master data management that gives every customer exactly one trusted golden record.
features: Rules that pick the truest value field by field.
A human workflow for the ambiguous matches.

products.name: Conduit
products.what:
Conduit is the real-time pipeline feeding the entity model, capturing change events from source systems and reconciling them into the graph continuously, so analytics and AI act on minutes-old truth instead of last night's batch.

Data & Entity Lab holds the CDC design, the reconciliation logic, and the freshness SLAs.
products.tagline: A streaming data layer that keeps the semantic model fresh in seconds, not nightly.
features: The graph stays consistent in near-real-time.
